timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’ve been searching my symptoms and I feel scared.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind has jumped to the worst possibility.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I keep reading things that make it worse.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I’m convinced something is seriously wrong.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels alarmed by what I’ve read.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want certainty and I can’t find it online.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me can’t stop searching for more.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this spiral has taken over.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: It’s late and this fear feels very loud.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can close this tab and come back to now.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: A search result isn’t a diagnosis.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can separate what I’m reading from what I actually know.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don’t have to find every possibility tonight.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can settle even without certainty.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can get real answers from a real person if I need them.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Fear is loud right now, but it isn’t the whole truth.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can be gentle with myself in this moment.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can set this worry down until morning.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust my body more than a search result.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can seek real care instead of spiraling alone.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel calm again.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can focus on the facts I actually have.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can rest even with unanswered questions.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I don’t have to solve this at 2am.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I’m capable of handling whatever this turns out to be.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can put the phone down now.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to let this rest until I can act on it.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
